tagline: The Lets go Brandon league newsletter · est. 2022
headline: TuanonStan Wins It on Monday Night, butterygoop Goes 9-0, and brettmn13 Scores 49.28
dek: Inside: the 1.06-point game that Monday flipped, butterygoop's 182.42, Colt45Johnson's seventh straight, the season's low score, Wallner's $100 quarterback a week on, three 4-5 teams for one playoff spot, the bracket if the season ended today, and every manager's story.
lead:
Monday night touched five of the six games and flipped one. triccster led TuanonStan by 5.54 going into the night; TuanonStan got 6.60 more and won 138.02 to 136.96, the closest game of the week.

At the top nothing moved. butterygoop is 9-0, the first team in league history to get there, and Colt45Johnson won his seventh straight to stay a game back at 8-1. Underneath them the week was rough: brettmn13 scored 49.28, the lowest score of the season, Wallner lost his second straight, and three teams sit at 4-5 with one playoff spot between them. triccster holds it, on points.

managers.text: Beat Thnu 182.42 to 98.40, the high score of the week. C.J. Stroud (36.36), CeeDee Lamb (32.5) and Javonte Williams (22.4) led it, and Darren Waller scored 27.0 on the bench. He is averaging 177 a game, his lowest score all season is 136.16, and his all-play record is .929. Gardner Minshew, on his roster, will miss the rest of the season after an elbow procedure, the Cardinals said Wednesday.
managers.next: Week 10: BROCKSTARxD. butterygoop has won three straight in the series, leads it 5-1 and is an 85% favorite.

managers.text: Beat brettmn13 143.24 to 49.28, a 93.96-point margin and the biggest of the week. Joe Burrow (29.54), Dak Prescott (18.5) and Rome Odunze (16.0) led it, and Kayshon Boutte scored 28.5 on the bench. His one loss came in week 2, in a week he scored 173.44, and he followed 197.26 in week 7 with 197.98 in week 8. His started players have beaten Sleeper's projections by 100.2 points, the most in the league. His one previous 8-1 start, in 2024, ended with the title.
managers.next: Week 10: Wallner, who he beat 197.3 to 129.74 in week 10 last year. Colt45Johnson leads the series 3-1 and is a 73% favorite.

managers.text: Beat triccster on Monday night behind Kenneth Walker (36.3) and Puka Nacua (34.0), with Luther Burden (19.7) third. George Pickens started and scored 0.0; he was inactive with a hamstring injury, and the Dallas coach expects him to practice Wednesday. Nacua is on injured reserve as of Wednesday with knee and toe injuries, and the Rams hope to have him back around week 14 or 15. Michael Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture. Denzel Boston, 15.8 on his bench this week, is the top-scoring rookie in the league at 102.7. TuanonStan has no quarterback in the top 24 on rest-of-season projections and is still 6-3.
managers.next: Week 10: brettmn13, who leads the series 4-2. TuanonStan won last year's meeting and is a 67% favorite.

managers.text: Beat Jbird531 153.74 to 96.74. Matthew Golden (32.4), Bijan Robinson (25.7) and Tee Higgins (20.2) led it; Jahan Dotson started for 3.6 and Juwan Johnson had 12.4 on the bench. He has left 319.1 points on his bench this season, the most in the league, and is 6-3 anyway, with the best bench in the league on projections. Golden and Robinson are both off in week 11: two pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 10: Thnu, a first meeting and the game of the week. HillBillyWorm is a 65% favorite.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: Lost to BROCKSTARxD 135.70 to 101.48, his lowest score of the season, against a team that came in 1-7. Isaiah Likely (18.8), Bo Nix (15.68) and Parker Washington (14.1) led it, and Jordan Watkins scored 18.6 on the bench. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve and needs thumb surgery. Jonathan Taylor stayed in Indianapolis through the trade deadline. Bo Nix and Joe Milton are both off in week 10: two pieces to replace. His started players are 109.7 points under Sleeper's projections.

Led into Monday and lost. Ja'Marr Chase (31.5), Bucky Irving (27.5) and Jonah Coleman (18.8) led it; Jared Goff scored 6.3, 13.28 under his average, and Tyler Shough had 17.7 on the bench. He is the hottest team in the league, 146.9 a game over the last three weeks, 17.3 above his season average, and has had 1,270.1 points scored against him, the most in the league: four straight wins, then two losses. He claimed Audric Estime for $25, dropping Xavier Restrepo, ahead of bids from HillBillyWorm ($22) and YoungBuck04 ($12). Irving and Jaylen Waddle are off in week 10: two pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 10: YoungBuck04, a first meeting. triccster is a 64% favorite.

managers.text: Beat YoungBuck04 111.56 to 86.48. Jordan Love (36.18), James Cook (16.7) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (16.6) led it; Mike Washington started for -0.3 and Justice Hill scored 18.2 on the bench. Jake Ferguson left week 9 with a knee injury, and the Dallas coach says he will miss multiple weeks. 4-5, and out of the field only on points.
managers.next: Week 10: Jbird531. The series is 2-2, DMsourbeer has won the last two, and he is a 63% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 182.42 to 98.40 to butterygoop. Christian Watson (30.1), Brock Bowers (24.8) and Efton Chism (15.9) led it, and Tommy Tremble scored 14.4 on the bench. Kyler Murray started and scored 0.0: he was ruled out of Monday's game with a hamstring injury, is week to week, and the Vikings coach says he will back up Kirk Cousins when healthy. Tyler Goodson has sprained knee ligaments and will miss multiple weeks. Watson, Davante Adams and Tucker Kraft are off in week 11: three pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 10: HillBillyWorm, a first meeting and the game of the week. Thnu is at 36%.

managers.text: The lowest score in the league this season, and the widest loss of the week. Jayden Daniels (13.56), Ollie Gordon (7.4) and Ashton Jeanty (7.0) led it. Josh Jacobs started and scored minus 0.5 after breaking a finger in the first quarter, and Bryce Young scored 20.34 on the bench, part of 32.72 left there. Jacobs has surgery this week and could be back in two to three weeks, per a Wednesday report. Players he brought in by trade or off the wire have started for 324.1 points, the most in the league. 4% to make the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 10: TuanonStan. brettmn13 leads the series 4-2 and is at 33%.

managers.text: Beat Wallner 135.70 to 101.48 to end six straight losses. Brock Purdy (26.28), Christian McCaffrey (22.7) and Travis Kelce (19.3) led it; Courtland Sutton scored 15.5 on the bench. Josh Downs, his, was traded to Kansas City. Baker Mayfield, Emeka Egbuka and Sutton are all off in week 10: three pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 10: butterygoop, who leads the series 5-1. BROCKSTARxD is at 16%.

managers.text: Lost 111.56 to 86.48. Shedeur Sanders (22.68), Dallas Goedert (12.5) and T.J. Hockenson (9.3) led it. Ladd McConkey started and scored 0.0 after hurting his back in warmups and leaving in the first quarter. Cleveland is going back to Deshaun Watson at quarterback this week, and the 49ers traded for his Keenan Allen. The fewest points in the league, and a 27% chance at last place.
managers.next: Week 10: triccster, a first meeting. YoungBuck04 is at 36%.

managers.text: Lost 153.74 to 96.74. Drake Maye (21.26), Omar Cooper (13.8) and Caleb Douglas (13.0) led it; Tank Dell scored 19.5 on the bench, part of 35.92 left there, the most of the week. He owns 18 picks from 2027 to 2029, five firsts and seven seconds, ten of them in 2027, the most capital in the league. Fernando Mendoza, his, was named the Raiders' starter after the Cousins trade. 1-8, and the model gives him a 57% chance at last place.

moves.intro: No trades. One $25 claim, and one free agent who would have flipped the closest game of the week.

items.title: Van Jefferson, for nobody
items.text: Jefferson scored 16.8 while unrostered that week. In for Jaylen Waddle (3.2), he flips triccster's 1.06-point loss to TuanonStan.
items.verdict: A free agent could have flipped at least one game here in six straight weeks.

items.title: The $100 quarterback, a week on
items.text: Wallner spent his whole $100 on Joe Fagnano in week 8, dropping Dawson Knox. Fagnano was brettmn13's cut in week 1. Wallner started him in the superflex for his first NFL start, and he scored 0.7. Baltimore has since finished its trade for Jacoby Brissett.
items.verdict: Wallner has no FAAB left for the last five weeks.

items.title: Three bids for Audric Estime
items.text: triccster won him for $25. HillBillyWorm bid $22 and YoungBuck04 $12.
items.verdict: triccster's first FAAB of the season.

trends.title: What nine weeks means here
trends.text: Both 8-1 teams in league history made the playoffs, and one won the title. All five 7-2 teams made it, 6-3 teams 8 times in 10, and all seven 5-4 teams, two of them champions. 4-5 teams made it 2 times in 9. None of the 15 teams at 3-6 or worse did.

trends.title: Two-team title race
trends.text: butterygoop is 47% to win the title and Colt45Johnson 34%. Between them they hold 82% of it.

trends.title: One spot, three 4-5 teams
trends.text: DMsourbeer is 42% to make the playoffs, triccster 41% and Thnu 32%. Thnu and YoungBuck04 are tied for the easiest schedule left on the model.

trends.title: TE premium payoff
trends.text: Jbird531 has gained 51.5 points from the half-point tight end bonus, top earner Tyler Warren. butterygoop is next at 47.0 (Trey McBride), then YoungBuck04 at 40.5 (T.J. Hockenson).

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 9 averaged 119.5 a team, the lowest week of the season, with a median of 123.63.

history.title: Week 9, all time
history.text: The highest week 9 score on record is DMsourbeer's 217.56 against butterygoop in 2024. The biggest week 9 margin is JMiiTcHH6511's 214.64 to 96.1 over jake188 in 2022. The closest is Colt45Johnson over brettmn13, 130.98 to 130.12, last year.

ahead: Game of the week: HillBillyWorm and Thnu, 6-3 against 4-5 in their first meeting, with Thnu a game out of the field. Also: triccster against YoungBuck04, another first meeting, with the sixth seed on the line, and Colt45Johnson against Wallner.
